messages.subject: Re: Square Of Number MapReduce , rmr2 ERROR
parts:
Loading required package: rmr2
Warning in library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE, :
 there is no package called ‘rmr2’

It looks like rmr2 and dependencies are not available on some node of the cluster. It can also happens that you installed them, but they are only available to one user and when you run a mapreduce job it is run as a different, hadoop-specific user.


Antonio
